CommunityApplications.Profile:
Warracker is a self-hosted warranty tracker. Keep track of all your warranties, receipts, and manuals in one place — with expiry notifications, document storage (local or Paperless-ngx), tags, claims, and CSV import/export.
This repository contains the Warracker application and its Unraid Docker template (unraid/warracker.xml). A PostgreSQL database is required: install a PostgreSQL container first, create a database and user, then install Warracker and point it at that database.
Support: GitHub Issues at https://github.com/sassanix/Warracker/issues
